info.title: Tiny OIDC JSON APIs
info.description: Interaction, Self-service and Admin APIs of Tiny OIDC. The OIDC protocol endpoints are described by the discovery document.

adminToken.description: An access token with scope admin and the issuer in aud (§9.1)

email.description: Only when the invitation has none, or in open mode

url.description: login_url?invitation=<token>, when a login_url is configured

failed.description: Members whose object was not updated

AdminClient.description: The client record without its secret hash (TIO-ADMIN-003); see §5.11 for every field

client_secret.description: Returned exactly once, for client_secret_basic/post clients

AdminClientCreated.description: The client record without its secret hash (TIO-ADMIN-003); see §5.11 for every field

AdminClientInput.description: The create body; every field of §5.11 is accepted

AdminClientPatch.description: Any subset of the create body except client_id

AdminUpstream.description: The upstream record without its secret or private key (TIO-ADMIN-003)

AdminUpstreamInput.description: The create body; every field of §4.1 upstreams is accepted

AdminUpstreamPatch.description: Any subset of the create body except alias

immediate.description: true makes the new key sign at once (emergency)

SettingsPatch.description: Setting name → new value, or null for the default

get.summary: The interaction document for the login app (§7.3)

post.summary: Authentication options with a fresh challenge (§7.4)
Verify an assertion and authenticate the interaction (§7.4)
Registration options under the registration policy (§7.4, §6.3)
Verify the registration, create or recover the user and authenticate the interaction (§7.4)
Grant or deny consent (§7.5)
Abort the interaction with access_denied (§7.5)
One-time bootstrap: admins group, admin-cli client and the first admin invitation (§9.3)

schema.description: Exact match on the verified email

parameters.description: Exact match on the verified email
parameters.name: email

post.summary: Create a user (§4.6 order); identities are linked at creation

get.summary: A user's profile from its Durable Object, with counts

patch.summary: Update email, email_verified, display_name or groups (replace)

200.description: Updated; partial_failure when the D1 mirror write failed

delete.summary: Delete a user and everything about them (TIO-DATA-010, TIO-PRIV-002)

post.summary: Disable a user: every session and refresh family is revoked (TIO-DATA-009)
Enable a disabled user

get.summary: The user's passkeys (metadata only, never public keys)

delete.summary: Remove a passkey (the object first, then the index)
Unlink an identity (no last-method rule for administrators)
Revoke every session and refresh family
Revoke one session and its session-bound families

get.summary: The user's live refresh families (never token material)

delete.summary: Revoke every refresh family of a client

get.summary: The user's consent grants for clients that still exist

delete.summary: Revoke the consent grant of a client

get.summary: The user's audit events from audit_hot (arrives with the audit endpoints)

post.summary: Create a recovery invitation for the user (TIO-REG-004)

201.description: The invitation with its one-time token

post.summary: Rebuild the user's D1 mirror and index rows from the object (TIO-DATA-027)

get.summary: Complete export of the user's state minus secrets (TIO-PRIV-002)

post.summary: Point-in-time recovery of the user's object (TIO-DEPLOY-003)

202.description: The restore is scheduled; the object restarts from the bookmark

post.summary: Create a group

get.summary: A group with its member count

patch.summary: Rename or describe a group; a rename is propagated to every member's object (at most 1,000 members per call)

delete.summary: Delete a group; the name leaves every member's object first (at most 1,000 members per call)

200.description: Deleted; `propagation.failed` lists members whose object kept the name

put.summary: Add a user to the group (object first, then the mirror)

200.description: The user's groups after the change

delete.summary: Remove a user from the group (object first, then the mirror)

200.description: The user's groups after the change

post.summary: Create a client; the secret, when the method uses one, is returned once (TIO-CLIENT-003)

400.description: invalid_client with the violations in error_description

patch.summary: Update a client; the merged record is validated as a whole. A switch to a secret method returns a new secret once

delete.summary: Delete a client; consent grants and refresh families are cleaned up lazily (TIO-CLIENT-005)

post.summary: Replace the secret immediately (TIO-CLIENT-003)

409.description: no_secret: the client's method uses no shared secret

post.summary: Disable a client: every grant, PAR, token and refresh operation fails within the cache window (TIO-CLIENT-004)
Enable a disabled client
Create an upstream; with discovery.mode auto the provider's document is fetched and checked (TIO-FED-001)

patch.summary: Update an upstream; the merged record is validated as a whole and auto discovery is fetched again

delete.summary: Delete an upstream; linked identities stay on their users

post.summary: Refetch the discovery document and the JWKS and report (TIO-FED-001)

200.description: The report; each part says whether it succeeded
A page of invitations (never their tokens)

post.summary: Create a register invitation; the token and URL are returned once (TIO-REG-002)

201.description: The invitation with its one-time token

delete.summary: Revoke an invitation: its token stops working at once

get.summary: Every signing key with its derived role; public JWKs only (§10.3)

post.summary: Create the next signing key, prepublished or immediate (TIO-KEYS-012)

delete.summary: Retire a key immediately; refused for the only active key (TIO-KEYS-013)

get.summary: Effective settings, each with its source (§12.2)

patch.summary: Change settings; null returns a key to its default; the whole is validated (TIO-CFG-003)

200.description: The effective settings after the change

400.description: invalid_request or invalid_settings with the violations

get.summary: Counts of users by status, clients, upstreams, keys by role, hot audit rows and the last cron run

post.summary: Run the cron body once, bounded (§12.4)
Re-encrypt one chunk of keystore rows under the active master key (TIO-CRYPTO-011)
Rebuild the D1 mirror of 100 users per call, in id order, resumable by cursor (TIO-DATA-027)
